reports.title: Context is now the product: Product leadership when software can build itself | Karri Saarinen
reports.summary: Linear's Karri Saarinen argues that AI tools keep getting more capable, but it is far from clear that teams are making better products or getting better themselves. Building a product has always produced two things, the product and the learning, and automating execution risks cutting teams off from…

Her fix is four practices: have a point of view, build your standards into the tools that…
